# Etihad Aviation Group Careers

> Etihad's dedicated careers portal connecting aviation professionals and UAE nationals with opportunities in airline operations, pilot training, and cabin crew roles.

Etihad Aviation Group operates a comprehensive recruitment platform based in Abu Dhabi, UAE, focused on attracting talent to the airline industry while supporting emiratisation initiatives and national workforce development programs.

## Key Topics

- Etihad Aviation Group
- Cadet Pilot Programme
- Cabin Crew Recruitment
- UAE Nationals
- Emiratisation
- Pilot Training
- Abu Dhabi
- Journey 2030
- Talent Community
- Engineering Operations
- Airline Industry
- Job Opportunities
- National Service
- Employee Benefits
- Aviation Careers

## Core Careers Hub

- [Jobs at Etihad | Etihad Aviation Group](https://careers.etihad.com): Etihad Aviation Group careers homepage with job listings and pilot recruitment
- [Careers Overview](https://careers.etihad.com/content/Careers/?locale=en_GB): Etihad careers overview featuring job opportunities and pilot training programs

## UAE National Programmes

- [UAE National Programme](https://careers.etihad.com/content/UAE-National-Programme/?locale=en_GB): UAE national programme for Emirati workforce development and graduate recruitment
